name: Happy Scribe
tagline: Happy Scribe is an AI transcription and subtitle platform that converts audio and video into accurate text in 60+ languages. It offers both automated transcription and a human proofreading service for higher-stakes content, along with a subtitle editor and direct export to SRT, VTT, and other formats. Journalists, researchers, and video teams use it to make their content searchable and accessible.
